violations.why: After enable_isr(1), irq_orchid can run between the task's check and reset, and its increment is overwritten by the reset.
Once orchid has enabled interrupt 2, irq_pylon can preempt the task between the check and the write and increment v_umber.
On a later orchid run, irq_pylon (enabled, higher priority) can preempt the read-modify-write in addData, so its update is lost.
